# Casper Network documentation

> The official Casper Network documentation (docs.casper.network), indexed from its source repository casper-network/docs-redux: the site publishes no llms.txt and answers every unknown path with its HTML homepage. This is documentation version 2.0.0, the one the site serves by default, plus its release notes and FAQ. The network has moved on since: casper-node's latest release is v2.2.2, and what changed after 2.0 is covered by the release notes and changelogs in casper-node-tools/llms.txt.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from casper-network/condor-info@a7af985, casper-network/docs-redux@c78e3c2.
